d:
Hello, I'm a magician.

This work is a prospectively drawn illustration that depicts the process by which a girl transforms into a monster in one painting.
So, I hadn't originally thought about making a difference, but... well, I just had to grow it all up.
I'm not sure who this girl was originally... but she was once a righteous heroine or just an ordinary person. Since he seems to have the aptitude for monsterization, it seems that within seconds of this painting he will be reborn as a complete evil warrior.
...Well, it's possible that he failed in his brainwashing, escaped, and will continue to fight in secret against evil organizations that have transformed themselves into dark heroes.
So, that might actually be more interesting, as there are a lot of naughty twists and turns, such as the penis that was given to you during the modification throbbing with each incident, or getting horny towards the enemy monster.

In short, although it's a short piece, I hope you enjoy it to some extent.

See you next time.
n: [Artist CG] [Fanbox] Mahouya (12160064) Tentacle Suit Forced Mutation
